text:
anna: FYI observed a weird token accounting spike on the console for a customer stream yesterday — looks like a toolcall happened, then a kv-snapshot/hand-off, and on reconnect the console shows both the tail of the stream and the toolcall tokens charged.

michael: Can you paste the minimal repro or logs? is this on canary?

anna: Can repro on staging. Repro steps pasted: 
1) start stream request (client seq 1)
2) service emits toolcall (external tool) midstream
3) runtime performs kv snapshot + hands off session between routers
4) reconnect resumes at prefix N, but ledger shows toolcall tokens and resumed stream tokens both consumed as if independent.

jess: do we treat toolcalls as part of the same session prefix? i thought toolcall tokens were attributed to the parent request id so should dedupe on resume.

sam: My guess: handoff creates ephemeral session id mapping -> when we resume, the router uses the new session id but the accounting lookup uses the old toolcall provenance (prefix capture) and we end up double counting.

michael: Can you share the exact lines from the accounting trace? need router trace + ledger entry.

anna: paste of anonymized trace: 
```
[router-A] session=svc-123 prefix_len=42 handoff->router-B seq=42
[router-B] resume session=svc-123-ephemeral seq_start=42 owned_prefix=false
[ledger] charge: session=svc-123 toolcall tokens=18 origin=toolcall-ctx-9
[ledger] charge: session=svc-123-ephemeral stream tokens=42 origin=stream-prefix-42
```
Seems origin tags differ so console shows two independent charges.

jess: sounds like provenance tag isn't normalized on handoff. We probably need to carry an authoritative origin id (client-request-id) through snapshot/handoff and use that to merge ledger entries at reconcile time.

sam: Agreed. Quick mitigation: when handoff occurs, set 'handoff_owner' field and have the resume path check for recent toolcall origins to suppress duplicate charging for overlapping token ranges. That feels hacky though.

michael: Long term: add canonical provenance id to session metadata -> ledger credits/charges attach canonical_id. On resume, ledger should detect same canonical_id and coalesce toolcall+stream origin ranges.

jess: Also need console UX change: show merged provenance and mark provisional charges vs confirmed so ops can spot duplicates.

anna: For now, can we add a short-lived rule in router-B to detect if resume seq overlaps a toolcall origin within X seconds and suppress second charge? I can open a small PR.

ops-bot: CI check for PR #? not available — please follow usual PR checklist (unit test, integration test for resume case).

michael: Sounds good. Anna, open PR with repro test harness + integration test that simulates handoff snapshot + resume with toolcall. I'll review. After that we should plan a follow-up to add canonical provenance id improvement.

anna: Will do. TL;DR: root cause = lost canonical provenance during kv-snapshot/handoff -> double-visible charges on console. Mitigation PR incoming. :+1:
